•Basic facilities like lift is not accessible. It becomes very difficult for senior citizens to climb the stairs as the banquet is on first floor.

featured_reviews.name: SANDEEP MOHAN
featured_reviews.review_text:
I attended my CINTAA ASSOCIATION ANNUAL MEETING HERE ON 01/05/26.I will present an honest appraisal of the place as I experienced it first hand.
First of all it was a grave error on the part of Poonam Dhillon ji, Padmini Kolhapure ji and Deepak Parashar ji to select this place as our annual meeting place.We had guests like Shatrughan Sinha ji and Bobby Deol ji amongst us.In the past during Amrish Puri ji's and Mithun Chakraborty Ji's tenure the meeting was held at Holiday Inn and later when the members swelled it was shifted to UPG auditorium juhu and then DN nagar auditorium.The last two were also better.
This is not a proper auditorium but a makeshift multipurpose place with a normal stage used for myriad functions like marriage and birthday anniversary celebrations.The tower aircons are effective.The stage lighting okay.The trasportable type old style chairs are not meant for sitting for six hours and are very very uncomfortable.If the meeting is going to be held for longer periods The organisers should ensure at least comfortable seating.The front few rows had sofa's which were also not comfortable and had low sitting position.
The meals are served in a semi basement semi open air kind of place.The pedestal fans with evaporation are ineffective during peak summers.I am told that the catering is reasonable as far the charges go,but then the fare served is also just about very average.The service by the bearers is not very visible and the place is meant for smaller gatherings and not large groups. It was a humbling experience standing in long temple like queues. There was a small tandoor in the beginning which slowed the line even further.The tables were few and far between and most people were eating standing or huddled in corners like labourers which was an ugly sight.The washroom was pathetic and totally avoidable.
THE ONLY GOOD THING ABOUT THIS PLACE IS AMPLE PARKING 🅿️ AVAILABLE IN THE ADJACENT OPEN AIR GROUND WHICH IS A BIG RELIEF.The approach road is a narrow and should be navigated with care.
Best wishes to CINTAA ASSOCIATION for next years ANNUAL MEETING and hoping that MVM Banquet management consider updating the dates facilities available and make it more in sync with the times we live in.
THANK YOU 🙏🏽

featured_reviews.name: Ann D'Souza
featured_reviews.review_text:
Atarah Banquet: A name you can trust for all your celebrations.
We recently hosted our son’s first birthday here, and we cannot stop praising this venue. Below is our honest and detailed review:

From my very first enquiry call, I was introduced to Ms. Mamta Jain, the main coordinator for our event. Mamta is someone you can share ideas with, and she will make them happen. Kudos to her for being patient and supportive through every call, message, and in-person meeting.

We opted for the Gold package (veg and non-veg), which included:

• 2 welcome drinks
• 2–3 starters
• 3 main course dishes
• 2 types of rice
• 1 dal dish
• 3 varieties of Indian breads
• 3 desserts
• 1 ice cream

We also added a Pan counter at a nominal cost. The best part of Atarah’s packages is the flexibility—you can customize everything to your preferences. For example, although the package included a Chinese dish, we replaced it with a Chaat counter (3 dishes), which turned out to be a fantastic choice.

Our menu selections:

• Welcome drinks: Watermelon cooler (mojito) and Guava chilli
• Starters (10/10):• Veg: Cheese corn balls, Veg spring rolls (not on the menu, but Atarah graciously obliged)
• Non-veg: Chicken chilli, Chicken tikka

• Main course (10/10):• Rice: Jeera rice, Dum biryani (veg & non-veg)
• Dal fry
• Veg: Tawa bhaji, Paneer lababdar, Dum aloo
• Non-veg: Chicken kadai, Chicken Afghani, Mutton sukha

• Indian breads (10/10): Puri, Butter roti, Garlic naan
• Desserts (10/10): Aamras, Angoor basundi, Rabdi jalebi• Special mention: The Aamras was the highlight—every guest went back for seconds!

• Ice cream (9/10): Kulfi slice
• Chaat (10/10): Pani puri, Katori chaat, Ragda patties
• Pan counter (10/10)

The package also included papad, pickle, mukhwas, and mineral water (200 ml).

We added activities like caricature and face painting. While the services were enjoyable, one regret was that the caricature artists left after two hours despite being booked for 200 guests. Unfortunately, even we—the hosts—didn’t get our portraits done.

Aside from this minor hiccup, everything else was flawless. From decorations (lights, stage, hall, seating) to music, food, and service, Atarah delivered perfection. Both Ms. Mamta and Mr. Jayesh coordinated with us until the very end, ensuring the event ran smoothly.

Final verdict:
Atarah Banquets exceeded our expectations and made our son’s first birthday truly memorable. We wholeheartedly recommend them to friends and family.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently hosted a very special memorial mehfil for our grandfather at Siddharth Banquets, and we couldn’t have asked for a better venue or team.

From start to finish, everything was organised flawlessly. The space was perfect for an intimate yet large gathering, and the entire team ensured that every detail was taken care of with warmth, professionalism, and genuine care.

A special mention as well to Forum Decorators for the absolutely beautiful setup. The fresh flower décor was elegant, tasteful, and perfectly in sync with the mood of the mehfil — everything was done to perfection.

A heartfelt thank you to Mr. Kiran and Mrs. Suri for going above and beyond to make the evening so smooth and meaningful for our family. Their support, attention to detail, and calm handling of everything allowed us to focus on what truly mattered — remembering and celebrating our grandfather.

We are truly grateful and would highly recommend Siddharth Banquets for any special occasion.

featured_reviews.name: Prajakta Namjoshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I went to this hall for family get-together function.
It's location is nice. Opp side of temple.
it's a near to Dadar West railway station.

When we enter for function they welcome us at counter with flowers, then  we had great breakfast. Taste and quality of breakfast was amazing.

well maintained hall at ground floor and first floor with best lunch services is available for get-together functions, birthday party, wedding, reception, etc.
You can get directions from your route to this destination hall via Google maps direction.

Catering services offers for food to serve or buffet and it is fresh and good quality food available.

Washroom is also clean and neat.service providers are very kind and co operative.

featured_reviews.name: Pradnya Namjoshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this place Lokmanya Nagar Banquet Hall Dadar for "Amhi Namjoshi Kul sammelan 2023" Family members gathering..
I used Google Maps for reached this place..I reached on time at the Hall..
I entered the Hall first counter is for welcome guest.. They welcome me with happiness and giving flower.. after second counter for registration guest and after that Taking Breakfast..
There is very fresh and tasty breakfast served with tea or coffee..
There is very fresh, energetic and pleasant atmosphere..
After taking breakfast program is started..
The program is very good .. some memories sharing with family members and nice meet and greet with family members..
After program taking lunch..
The beautiful "Pangat" arrengement..
There is very co-operative and helpful staff..
There is very fresh and tasty food served with happiness..
I enjoyed this beautiful day at "Lokmanya Nagar Banquet Hall Dadar"..
This Hall is very beautiful and neat and clean.. There is toilet facilities also available..
Thank you 🙏😊

featured_reviews.name: Pradeep Khot
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent complete air conditioned hall with very very good food as well. The main hall for function is on the first floor and ground floor is used to serve food. It is very clean and neat. Very nice location indeed. This  hall is good for about 150 to 200 people and really clean and recently renovated so great ambience. Very appropriate for small ceremonies.
